quotes.text: Standing in the dock at Southampton / Trying to get to Holland or France / The man in the mac said / You've got to go back / You know they didn't even give us a chance
quotes.reference: 1969, John Lennon, Paul McCartney, 0:04 from the start, in The Ballad of John and Yoko (music video), The Beatles (actor), Vevo, published 2017:

senses.definition: (UK, US, Canada, Australia, slang, offensive, derogatory, ethnic slur) A person of Scottish descent (used in driving culture to denigrate someone for poor/slow/amateurish driving responses).

examples: Is there any mac and cheese left?

quotes.text:
Who wrote "kick me" on my back?
Who put a spider in my mac?

quotes.text: Nothing tastes better to me than a big ol' bowl of super creamy, cheesy mac!
